How to get it :
No direct recipe: ore, loot, assembled structure or by-product. See JEI (R key).

Used to make :
[[Uranium-238|Uranium-238 Nugget]], [[Thorium-232|Thorium-232 Nugget]], [[Uranium-233|Uranium-233 Nugget]], [[gv:nuclear_waste_tiny|Tiny Pile of Nuclear Waste]].

[[Uranium-238|Pépite de d'U238]], [[Thorium-232|Pépite de thorium-232]], [[Uranium-233|Pépite d'uranium-233]], [[gv:nuclear_waste_tiny|Petit tas de déchets nucléaires]].
